ex_lb: Ass an der Cola gradesou vill Koffein ewéi am Kaffi?
ex_en: Is there as much caffeine in cola as in coffee?

ex_lb: Dat Mineralwaasser ass mir ze salzeg.
ex_en: This mineral water is too salty for me.

ex_lb: Eise Grosist kritt de Kakao a grousse Säck geliwwert.
ex_en: Our wholesaler gets cocoa delivered in big sacks.

ex_lb: Mir hunn op enger Terrass en Espresso gedronk.
ex_en: We had an espresso on a terrace.

ex_lb: Ech huelen e Cappuccino.
ex_en: I'll have a cappuccino.

ex_lb: D'Kand drénkt Apel-Jus.
ex_en: The child drinks apple juice.

ex_lb: Du houschts nach ëmmer, hues de däi Sirop scho geholl?
ex_en: You're still coughing, have you taken your syrup yet?

ex_lb: An dëser Zooss schmaacht een d'Gewierzer gutt eraus.
ex_en: You can really taste the spices in this sauce.

ex_lb: De Kach huet d'Zooss mat Miel gebonnen.
ex_en: The cook thickened the sauce with flour.

ex_lb: An eise Géigende gëtt kee Räis ugeplanzt.
ex_en: No rice is grown in our part of the world.

ex_lb: Drénk Mëllech mat Hunneg, da vergeet däin Halswéi!
ex_en: Drink milk with honey and your sore throat will go away!

ex_lb: Mäi Brudder ass esou verfroossen, datt en eng ganz Këscht Kichelcher beieneen eragefeiert huet.
ex_en: My brother is such a glutton that he wolfed down a whole box of biscuits at once.

ex_lb: D'Kanner hunn d'Bonbonen all beienee giess!
ex_en: The children ate all the sweets at once!

ex_lb: Maach net ze vill Esseg an d'Zooss!
ex_en: Don't put too much vinegar in the sauce!

ex_lb: Et ass eng Gerot, ob meng Mayonnaise eppes gëtt oder net.
ex_en: It's a matter of luck whether my mayonnaise turns out or not.

ex_lb: Tomatepüree ass net dat selwecht ewéi Ketchup.
ex_en: Tomato purée is not the same as ketchup.

ex_lb: Schmier de Brot mat Moschter an!
ex_en: Spread the bread with mustard!

ex_lb: D'Plattoe ware mat Péiterséileg garnéiert.
ex_en: The platters were garnished with parsley.

ex_lb: Kaffi mat Schmull.
ex_en: Coffee with cream.

ex_lb: Ech gi fir d'Kaffispaus bei de Bäcker Croissante sichen.
ex_en: I'm going to the baker's for croissants for the coffee break.

ex_lb: Mir hu gëschter bal eng ganz Tut Chipse virun der Tëlee giess.
ex_en: Yesterday we ate almost a whole bag of crisps in front of the TV.

ex_lb: Ech iesse gär Nëss.
ex_en: I like nuts.

ex_lb: Pizza mat Oliven.
ex_en: Pizza with olives.

ex_lb: Mir hunn op der Kiermes en Hamburger an eng Portioun Fritte giess.
ex_en: At the fair we ate a hamburger and a portion of chips.

ex_lb: Ech brode mer heiansdo e gudde säftege Bifdeck.
ex_en: I sometimes fry myself a good juicy steak.

ex_lb: Soll ech eis den Owend eng Omlett mat Champignone maachen?
ex_en: Shall I make us a mushroom omelette tonight?

ex_lb: Ech hätt emol erëm Loscht op eng Geméiszopp mat Paangecher!
ex_en: I'd love a vegetable soup with pancakes again!

ex_lb: Der Boma hir Quetschentaart ass nach ëmmer déi bescht!
ex_en: Grandma's plum tart is still the best!

ex_lb: D'Kanner hunn eng Äppeltaart mat Äppel aus dem Bongert gebak.
ex_en: The children baked an apple tart with apples from the orchard.

ex_lb: Ech maachen ëmmer e bësse Muskat an de Gromperepüree.
ex_en: I always put a bit of nutmeg in the mashed potatoes.

ex_lb: Soll ech eis nach zwee Cremante bestellen?
ex_en: Shall I order us two more glasses of crémant?

ex_lb: Haut hu mer de ganzen Dag Riesling gelies.
ex_en: Today we spent the whole day picking Riesling.

ex_lb: Ech sichen e gutt Rezept.
ex_en: I'm looking for a good recipe.

ex_lb: De Kach huet d'Brietchen erausgeholl, fir d'Ënnen drop ze schneiden.
ex_en: The cook took out the chopping board to cut the onions on it.

ex_lb: Ech hunn en extrae Mixer, fir Milkshaken ze maachen.
ex_en: I have a separate blender for making milkshakes.

ex_lb: Huel d'Fleesch scho mueres fréi aus der Killtru!
ex_en: Take the meat out of the freezer early in the morning!

ex_lb: D'Subside vun de Gemenge sinn zäitweileg agefruer ginn.
ex_en: The municipalities' subsidies have been temporarily frozen.

ex_lb: D'Käche kacht d'Geméiszopp an engem groussen Dëppen.
ex_en: The cook makes the vegetable soup in a big pot.

ex_lb: De Krou ass erofgefall a gebrach.
ex_en: The jug fell down and broke.

ex_lb: Et deet mer leed, ech hunn aus Versinn däin Eemer ëmgehäit.
ex_en: I'm sorry, I accidentally knocked over your bucket.

ex_lb: War dat däin Date, mat deem ech dech gëschter an der Stad gesinn hunn?
ex_en: Was that your date I saw you with in town yesterday?

ex_lb: Pech d'Etikett mat der Adress op d'Enveloppe!
ex_en: Stick the address label on the envelope!

ex_lb: D'Vendeuse huet d'Ham mam Pabeier gewien.
ex_en: The saleswoman weighed the ham together with the paper.

ex_lb: Ass deng Wo iwwerhaapt geeicht?
ex_en: Are your scales even calibrated?

ex_lb: Ech kafe gär bio Uebst.
ex_en: I like to buy organic fruit.

ex_lb: D'Qualitéit vun deem Stoft ass mëttelméisseg.
ex_en: The quality of that fabric is mediocre.

ex_lb: D'Supermarchéë sinn eng grouss Konkurrenz fir déi kleng Epicerien.
ex_en: Supermarkets are strong competition for the small grocery shops.

ex_lb: Wëllt Der Räis oder Fritten als Bäiluecht?
ex_en: Would you like rice or chips as a side?

ex_lb: Wat empfeelt Dir?
ex_en: What do you recommend?

ex_lb: An der Hetz hat ech vergiess, e Prabbeli matzehuelen.
ex_en: In the rush I forgot to take an umbrella.

ex_lb: Dem Kach seng Spezialitéit ass Fierkelshämmche mat gebootschte Gromperen.
ex_en: The cook's speciality is pork knuckle with roast potatoes.

ex_lb: D'Schüler ginn all Dag an d'Kantin.
ex_en: The pupils go to the canteen every day.

ex_lb: Um Bal ass fir Iessen a Gedrénks gesuergt.
ex_en: Food and drink are provided at the ball.
